name: ScnClassFlags
meaning: class-registry flag bits: g_scnClassRegistry[classId].classFlags (u32 at 0x6cffe4 + classId*0x10)

name: SCN_CF_SHEEP_ATTRACTOR
meaning: Sheep_AttractorScoreCB 0x4784ca sends msg 2 only to classes with it

name: SCN_CF_CARRIER
meaning: recorded as ContactInfo.carrierObj; blocks Wolf put-down on top

name: SCN_CF_08
meaning: Scenaric_RegisterClass_2 passes 0x9 for the Daffy classes; no reader in the census (inferred)

name: SCN_CF_SEESAW_SNAP
meaning: seesaw_Update translates the body by the plank gap when it did not handle msg 0xb (Wolf, Sheep, Rock, box, items…)

name: SCN_CF_SNAP_TO_SUPPORT
meaning: pulled onto its support even when above it (ground snap). Set on 12 classes: Dynamite, Salad, Perfume, Bush, DefusableMine, 3 costumes, HoneyPot, Key, InflatableSheep, GoldenCoins. Does NOT mean carryable: the Bush is not carried in game (Ralph gets inside it and is hidden from Sam). Name inferred

name: SCN_CF_GROUND_PROVIDER
meaning: ObjGrid_QueryGroundY 0x472380 sends msg 0xD (MSG_GROUND_QUERY) only to these classes: seesaw, Rock, Wooden Lift, WoodenPlatForm, Raft, Catapult, Snowball, SnowyGround, IceGround, WheelDummy, RollingCarpet, RCarpetMobile, CrumblyGround, Jail, Train, FloatingBox, Case, CrumblyPlat. Name inferred from use

name: SCN_CF_COMPONENT_ITEM
meaning: Set only on Magnet (66) and FishingRod (67), the two parts of the composite rods. No reader of bit 0x100 found among the 34 direct reads of 0x6cffe4 (some masks are in registers), so the name is inferred

name: SCN_CF_INVENTORY_ITEM
meaning: the class appears as a row on the map/inventory screen; Map_InitObject selects classes with 0x400 set and 0x200 clear, and Map_Open / Map_AcquireItem test it before converting an object to a list row

name: SCN_CF_SHEEP_ANCHORABLE
meaning: Sheep only; matches SheepMsg 0x2e MSG_SET_ANCHOR (seesaw walk-to-end)

name: SCN_CF_IGNORED_BY_BUTTONS
meaning: SensibleButton_Update skips these objects. reg_arg3 has it for SensibleButton(24), CannonBall(95), DancingGhost(127), PrayingGhost(130), Train(135)
